mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_tasks (id, user_id, title, session_id, pinned, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{sessionId}, #{pinned}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, session_id, pinned, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pinned DESC, updated_at DESC
